caption:
Watch the seven planets click into line 🎧

Moon 210.42 · Mercury 141.27 · Venus 221.23 · Sun 136.10 · Mars 144.72 · Jupiter 183.58 · Saturn 147.85 Hz

Every tone is that planet's real cycle (one Venus year, one Mars year, one moon from new to new), doubled again and again until it lands where you can hear it. Fastest at the bottom, slowest at the top: the order the old astrologers gave the sky.
